interpretation: Neither frozen real-data contract contains the observational unit needed to revive HYP-0001. Both provide supervised temporal transition pairs and evaluator-owned grouping; neither provides multiple unlabeled views of a persistent entity. Creating record-linkage labels, pair-breaking fixtures or an identity oracle would therefore add the missing ontology rather than test acquisition from observation.
uncertainty: Confidence 0.995 for the candidate-interface finding because it follows directly from frozen dataclasses and constructors. Confidence is lower, 0.85, that no useful identity relation exists anywhere in the raw archives: raw data were deliberately not inspected beyond the candidate boundary, and a future independently justified contract could expose a different natural observational unit.
next_cycle: One no-scoring primary-literature and portfolio review after the five consecutive identifiability/mechanism feasibility failures in cycles 129-133. Select at most one genuinely different principle only if an existing frozen cohort can test its qualitative signature at three scales against matched classical controls; otherwise record that no scored experiment is currently justified and specify the minimal missing observational contract without creating it.
